  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The test validates extracted heredoc text instead of the actual workflow file content, so it can pass even if the real workflow still has indentation that breaks Python at runtime.
  WHY: The extraction step strips leading whitespace before the assertion, masking the workflow’s true indentation.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2003-2050 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The Python heredoc body in `upsert_repair_reasoning_into_config` is still indented, which will trigger `IndentationError: unexpected indent` when the workflow runs.
  WHY: Quoted bash heredocs pass content verbatim to Python, so leading spaces in the body are interpreted as code indentation and break execution.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2062-2075 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: When prompt rendering fails, the workflow falls back to the raw repair prompt template with unresolved placeholders.
  WHY: The raw template is sent directly to Codex without rendering, so literal tokens like `{{SERENA_TOOL_HINTS}}` can reach the model and distort the prompt.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2485-2498 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The Serena cleanup only removes `.serena/project.yml` and then tries `rmdir .serena`, leaving any other Serena-generated files behind.
  WHY: If Serena creates additional state under `.serena/`, those files can remain visible to `git status` and be staged as unintended implementation changes.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:105-108 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Serena preexistence detection runs before checkout, so `SERENA_PROJECT_PREEXISTED` is always false.
  WHY: `git ls-files --error-unmatch -- .serena/project.yml` executes against an empty workspace with no git repository, and `[ -e .serena/project.yml ]` checks a file that has not been checked out yet.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:477-485 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the Serena template source exists and `is_self_repo=false`, the workflow unconditionally installs `scripts/templates/serena_project.yml.j2`, overwriting any consumer-owned template at that path.
  WHY: The `install -m 0644` step does not check whether the destination already exists or is tracked by the consumer repository.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2485-2498 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The Serena cleanup only removes `.serena/project.yml` and attempts `rmdir .serena`, so any additional Serena runtime files can be left behind.
  WHY: If Serena writes other files under `.serena/`, `rmdir` fails on a non-empty directory and the remaining files can later be staged as repository changes.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2003-2050 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Python code inside the `upsert_repair_reasoning_into_config` heredoc remains indented with leading spaces, which causes `IndentationError: unexpected indent`.
  WHY: Bash passes quoted heredoc content verbatim to Python, so the leading spaces before `from pathlib import Path` are preserved and Python rejects the block.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:98-110 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Serena preexistence check runs before `actions/checkout`, so it always evaluates to false and never recognizes an existing `.serena/project.yml`.
  WHY: The workspace is empty when the check runs, so both `git ls-files --error-unmatch -- .serena/project.yml` and `[ -e .serena/project.yml ]` miss any repo-owned file.
- tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py:1135-1143 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test validates extracted text from `_extract_run_script()` instead of the actual workflow file, so it can pass even when the workflow still contains broken indentation.
  WHY: `_extract_run_script()` strips leading whitespace before the assertion, which masks the indentation that will exist in the real YAML block at runtime.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:105-110 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Serena preexistence check runs before `actions/checkout`, so `SERENA_PROJECT_PREEXISTED` is always `"false"`.
  WHY: The workspace is empty at that point, so a consumer repo that already tracks `.serena/project.yml` is misclassified as bootstrap-generated and can be deleted later.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:481-485 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `install -m 0644 "${serena_template_src}" "scripts/templates/serena_project.yml.j2"` step unconditionally overwrites any existing consumer template.
  WHY: If a consumer repo tracks a customized `scripts/templates/serena_project.yml.j2`, this step silently replaces it with the upstream copy and the custom version is then lost.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2488-2493 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The Serena cleanup only removes `.serena/project.yml` and then attempts `rmdir .serena`, so any other Serena-created files remain in the working tree.
  WHY: Leftover cache or state files under `.serena/` can survive the cleanup and appear as untracked files that may be committed with the implementation PR.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
